title: T1585 — Establish Accounts
subtitle: Watch the full story of an attacker establishing accounts, from signup to detection.
aria: Animation of an attacker creating accounts at a registrar and a SaaS provider, using them against a target organization, and a SOC responding.

steps.title: Planning
steps.caption: The attacker picks the target and chooses which services to abuse: a registrar for a domain, a provider for mailboxes and hosting. Nothing has touched the victim yet, so there is no signal
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
